'''Adar 6 (April 18)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*{{ne|999}} - [[Gaul]] is caught by [[Orban]] and his followers, and caged in [[Remen]].
*{{ne|1000}} - In the early morning, [[Furyk Karede]] and [[Musenge]] arrive at [[Gamel Loune]]'s camp. Loune tells him about the attacks the [[Seanchan]] have suffered over the last week,  which Karede thinks are being masterminded by [[Thomdril Merrilin]].
